name: Control / ManufacturerAccess (SBS 0x00)
caller: fg_read_sbs_word (CNTL branch, descriptor bit 26); fg_gauge_unseal; AFI record (write 45 00)
runtime_purpose: probe identity: write 0x0001, mdelay(10) ONLY if the write failed, read back word; unseal: 0x5678,0x1234,0xCDEF,0x90AB (3 ms each); AFI activation 0x0045

name: DeviceType (control)
runtime_purpose: probe fails with -ENOMEM if value != 0x0603; value exported as /sys/class/3rd-gauge/chipid (decimal)

name: Temperature (SBS)
runtime_purpose: batt_temp = (s16)raw - 2731 (0.1 degC); also read via regs[9] in runstate check (raw-2731 into local, unused)

name: Voltage (SBS)
runtime_purpose: batt_volt = raw mV (exported unchanged as VOLTAGE_NOW, i.e. mV not uV)

name: BatteryStatus (SBS)
runtime_purpose: logged only (BatS:0x%04x)

name: Current (SBS)
caller: fg_read_Current (probe, monitor, runstate); monitor re-reads raw for the log
runtime_purpose: batt_curr = |(s16)raw| * 1000 (uA, sign discarded); log prints signed mA

name: RemainingCapacity (SBS)
runtime_purpose: logged only

name: FullChargeCapacity (SBS)
runtime_purpose: CHARGE_FULL_DESIGN = FCC mAh; AFI auto-update when FCC < 3500

name: Internal temperature
runtime_purpose: result discarded (return value unused)

name: CycleCount (SBS)
runtime_purpose: CYCLE_COUNT; input of synthetic sysfs soh

name: RelativeStateOfCharge (SBS)
runtime_purpose: CAPACITY; STATUS FULL when ==100 and charger online

name: StateOfHealth (SBS)
runtime_purpose: logged only (not the sysfs soh)

name: ChargingVoltage (SBS)
runtime_purpose: logged only; not used for charging policy

name: ChargingCurrent (SBS)
runtime_purpose: logged only; not used for charging policy

name: AltManufacturerAccess (MAC selector)
meaning: MAC subcommand selector; AFI data-flash address+payload port
caller: fg_read_sbs_word (ALTMAC branch, bit 27); fg_read_block; fg_write_word (seal/reset/enable); AFI records
runtime_purpose: write subcommand, msleep(3), read response

name: MACData
runtime_purpose: response payload

name: MACDataChecksum / MACDataLength
mask: low byte = checksum, high byte = length
meaning: block checksum check; AFI commit port
runtime_purpose: block valid iff length>4 and ~(cmd_lo + sum(data[0..len-5])) == checksum; length<=4 is accepted without check

name: ManufactureDate write (raw, not MAC)
runtime_purpose: only if MAC 0x004D reads 0; unseal, up to 5 attempts, seal. Writes buf[0]=date>>8, buf[1]=date&0xff to I2C register 0x4D

name: DeviceType (MAC)
caller: fg_get_device_id via regs[0]=0x08000001 (hal_fg_init after update work)
runtime_purpose: logged only (device_id = 0x%04X)

name: Gauging enable (stock log: "gauge disable")
runtime_purpose: sent when OEMFlag bit 14 clear; msleep(1000)

name: Seal
caller: fg_gauge_seal (end of Check_Chip_Version, file_decode_process, runstate check, date write)
runtime_purpose: followed by OperationStatus read + log

name: Reset
runtime_purpose: only when batt_curr<=0 and (volt>4000000&&soc<10 | volt>3850000&&soc<3 | soc==0&&volt-term_volt>200000); with mV/|uA| caches this is unreachable on GQ5012BF1 (see yft-sh366003-deltas.md D7)

name: AFI static checksum
caller: Check_Chip_Version; AFI final compare (raw 0x3E read of 4 bytes == 46 00 d3 8c)
runtime_purpose: target 0x8CD3; logged, not used for the auto-update decision

name: ManufacturerName
runtime_purpose: /sys/class/3rd-gauge/manufacturename

name: ManufactureDate / profile date (stock calls it fwno)
runtime_purpose: auto-update if != 0x5A93 (2025-04-19); manufacturing_date/year/month/day sysfs; fw_version string

name: SerialNumber
runtime_purpose: /sys/class/3rd-gauge/serialnum (%04d)

name: SafetyAlert, SafetyStatus, PFAlert, PFStatus, OperationStatus, ChargingStatus, GaugingStatus, ManufacturingStatus
runtime_purpose: logged only; read aborts on first failure

name: OperationStatus
runtime_purpose: unseal "ok" iff (val & 0x0300)==0; unseal ALWAYS returns 0 once the key writes succeeded

name: Max cell voltages (block)
runtime_purpose: maxvoltage = v1 + v2 (2S); stored, not exported

name: DAStatus1
runtime_purpose: logged as da_status1=[0x%04X(%d),0x%04X(%d)]

name: OEM flags
runtime_purpose: bit14 clear -> MAC 0x0021; bit15 clear -> MAC 0x0067

name: Run-state block
runtime_purpose: loop ends on first successful block read (checksummed)

name: Lifetime data enable
runtime_purpose: when OEMFlag bit 15 clear; msleep(1000)

name: Manufacturer info ASCII
runtime_purpose: fuelgauge_fw_version "Vno:0x%02x-%s(%02d%02d)\n" (exported to yft_devinfo)

name: SinoFS AFI data-flash program
runtime_purpose: 104 writes (51 via 0x3E, 51 via 0x60, 0x00 <- 45 00, 0x3E <- 46 00), 104 waits, 1 compare; see battery-profile.md
